keywords_en: Client default gas limit set to 60M
privacy tools not working with smart accounts like Safe
several EOF related EIPs moved to Stagnant
summary_en: nixorokish said client default gas limits are now 60M. koeppelmann noted privacy tools do not work with smart accounts like Safe, missing multisig and recovery, which bermudabayzk aims to fix. eth-bot moved several EOF related EIPs such as EIP-663 and EIP-7069 to Stagnant.
